normalized.description: An X-ray scattering measurement goniometer setup is sought for the characterization of the structure and morphology of a wide scope of solid materials and especially battery materials under operando conditions. The setup should include the optics to perform X-ray diffraction and total diffraction (PDF) with an Ag X-ray source.
